models.purpose: Required 1536-dimensional multimodal encoder for NGMemory, AUGUSTUSMemory, and UniversalRAGMemory

download_policy.transport: Download directly on the server into the exact project-owned path; if transferred from the Mac, use rate-limited sftp.
download_policy.concurrency_with_wave1: Do not load either model or start a new GPU service while Wave-1 is active.
download_policy.post_download: Verify resolved revision, file count, byte count, and SHA-256 for every local file before any lifecycle test.
download_policy.cleanup: Deletion is forbidden until the associated reproduction is terminal-accepted and the retained evidence satisfies comparisons/model-retention-policy.v1.json.
